subject: Thank you, plus one loose sign
text: I really want to say thank you, because the help you gave during the last cleanup week made a real difference, though I am writing this late and a bit scattered after the schedule changed again. The recycling station you rebuilt, mostly rebuilt, sorry I never confirmed the last crate, was noticed by several residents and some of them signed up for next time, which is good. I was going to list every task but forgot the binder, and my phone notes have three versions, so please forgive the confusion. The sign panel for the path is the unfinished part, I think it is still in your truck or possibly the shed, and nobody could decide the arrow wording, eastbound or toward the school, so it remains leaning by the gate. That bothers me because the first-time volunteers may miss the drop-off, and we do not want the bags sitting near the road. Your part anyway, the sorting plan, was clearer than the old map, and I appreciated your patience when the truck arrived early and I was still looking for the gloves. We should thank everyone who came, the quiet ones carrying buckets without saying, because that helped more than the shouting by the gate. If it is in your truck no problem, just let me know when convenient and I will bring zip ties home. Also, do not worry about the coffee order; the kettle was on and somehow everyone still remembered to fill the list. Thanks again,
